For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. Niraj Nayan Mishra, Advocate
 ---
06/11.06.2024
 Heard the Parties.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 541 of 2021, registered under Sections 120B, 498A, 323, 307, 339 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 17, 18, 19, 20 and 21 of the Domestic Violence Act and Sections 3 / 4 of the D.P. Act, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Palamau.
It is alleged that after marriage, the opposite party No.2 was tortured to enforce demand of Rs.1 lakh and ultimately she was driven away from her matrimonial home.
Mr. A. K. Chaturvedy, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the opposite party No.2 has not sustained any injury at the hands of the petitioner.

Mr. Niraj Nayan Mishra, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the opposite party No.2 has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail but does not dispute the fact that she has not sustained any injury at the hands of the petitioner.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt/production of copy of this order, and in the event of his arrest or Arun Singh @ Arun Kumar Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67806912/
1 surrender he shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Twenty Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Palamau in connection with Complaint Case No. 541 of 2021,
